summary: A resolution dies at the county meeting because nobody from the precinct is there to bring it up.
realLife: A report from Washington County tied the absence of the third precinct’s delegates to its party-loyalty resolution never reaching the convention.
gates: The resolution requires someone eligible to introduce it.
inGame: needs: a precinct resolution, its authorized mover and actual attendance.

turns.pulledBy: An alternate arrives before resolutions close.
turns.writesBack: The minutes carry a disposition for the precinct’s proposal.

turns.what: Its delegate presents it at the next eligible meeting.
turns.pulledBy: Another precinct adopts the same proposal afterward.
turns.writesBack: The record credits the precinct that actually moved it.
